description: This file defines the HomeFragment class for an Android TV application using Kotlin. It constructs the main home screen UI with a top navigation bar, hero carousel, Continue Watching, and TV Channels sections. It manages focus routing, auto-scrolling hero carousel, and dynamic layout adjustments to ensure an overscan-safe, pixel-accurate layout consistent with high-end TV display standards.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: Main fragment managing the home screen layout, data loading, focus management, and carousel behaviors in the Android TV app.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Creates and configures the main view hierarchy, including focusable components and layout setup.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets initial focus, observes ViewModel states, and initiates data loading.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Restores focus and resumes auto-scrolling when fragment is resumed.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Pauses auto-scrolling and cancels animations to prevent leaks.

methods.name: observeViewModelStates
methods.description: Observes LiveData from ViewModel to update UI sections.

methods.name: showContinueWatchingLoading
methods.description: Displays loading indicator for Continue Watching section.

methods.name: hideContinueWatchingLoading
methods.description: Hides loading indicator for Continue Watching section.

methods.name: showTvChannelsLoading
methods.description: Displays loading indicator for TV Channels section.

methods.name: hideTvChannelsLoading
methods.description: Hides loading indicator for TV Channels section.

methods.name: showErrorWithRetry
methods.description: Displays an error message and retries data loading after delay.

methods.name: updateContinueWatchingRail
methods.description: Populates Continue Watching rail with data and sets focus routing.

methods.name: updateTvChannelsRail
methods.description: Populates TV Channels rail with data.

methods.name: addComposeTopNavBar
methods.description: Creates and adds a Compose-based top navigation bar with initial focus and D-pad handling.

methods.name: setupHeroBanner
methods.description: Configures horizontally scrolling hero carousel, manages focus, auto-scrolling, and layout measurements for overscan-safe design.

methods.name: centerHeroAt
methods.description: Centers a hero card at a given index with optional animation and peeking layout.

methods.name: setRailsFocusable
methods.description: Enables or disables focus on content rails.

methods.name: dpToPx
methods.description: Utility to convert density-independent pixels to actual pixels.
